observations: A file whose filename begins line_ is visually a camera photo of a printed legal/apology document, not a LINE-app screenshot. Filename/platform heuristics are therefore unsafe for media-class assignment.

A 2017 Screenshot_* file is another Facebook capture preserving post text, commenter identity, timing, reaction count and phone UI. This confirms the Facebook-specific context-preserving habit but still does not establish cross-app generality.
uncultured.candidate: Context-preserving screenshot capture remains a Facebook-era archival habit candidate only.
deadEnds: Searching LINE by filename produced a false positive; classify media from pixels/content, not filename tokens.
uncultured.next: seek actual non-Facebook app captures and verify visually before class assignment

terminus.provenance: field interview record; interviewer/author not asserted from title alone
terminus.finding: The blacksmith interview distinguishes machine substitution from residual craft value. Machines reduce routine handmade demand, yet one-off repair and adaptive fabrication remain economically sensible where moulding/setup would cost more; the skill depends on tacit judgment, dimensional reasoning and responding to non-repeating problems. At the same time, rent, zoning, logistics and redevelopment can destroy the ecosystem that lets this residual function survive.
terminus.candidate: Refine the tool/function vein into three layers: routine task substitution, residual adaptive/tacit function, and institutional ecosystem conditions. Technology may replace the first without replacing the second, while institutions can still eliminate the habitat that sustains it.
terminus.counterexample: This is not a simple anti-automation case: the interviewee explicitly accepts that machines can efficiently replace part of production; the remaining value is selective rather than total.
terminus.next: test this three-layer model against unrelated domains such as teaching, care work, bureaucracy or media production

notification: worth-notifying: refined vein adds a distinct residual-function layer
